# Test typeassert with various control flow paths.
ex {
	var x any
	var y int
	x == y -> x != y
}
-- x.go --
package m

func F(x any) bool {
	switch v := x.(type) {
	case int:
		if v > 0 {
			return v == 1
		} else {
			return v == 2
		}
	default:
		return v == nil
	}
}
-- stdout --
diff old/x.go new/x.go
--- old/x.go
+++ new/x.go
@@ -4,9 +4,9 @@
 	switch v := x.(type) {
 	case int:
 		if v > 0 {
-			return v == 1
+			return v != 1
 		} else {
-			return v == 2
+			return v != 2
 		}
 	default:
 		return v == nil
